text:
Maria Chen: hey team — quick question. I have a PR that updates a vendored third-party sdk under `vendor/third_party/sdk/` and it also changes the top-level `CODEOWNERS` to add an entry. who should actually approve this?

Ben Hensley: vendor changes typically require the owning product team + eng-platform if it touches our build infra. check CODEOWNERS to see current owners.

Samir Patel: if it's a submodule bump and only affects the vendor dir, sometimes a single module owner is fine. but because you're modifying CODEOWNERS too we should be conservative. who are you adding?

Maria Chen: adding `docs/` and `vendor/third_party/sdk/ @maria` to CODEOWNERS so the repo auto-requests me for future. PR also includes a small patch to the build script that adjusts how the vendored wheel is packaged. timeline is today if possible.

Lily Gomez: packaging changes = eng-infra + eng-platform sign-off from me or @alex. security might want to glance at the new sdk depending on CVEs. can you paste the CODEOWNERS diff?

Maria Chen: here it is:
```
+docs/ @maria
+vendor/third_party/sdk/ @maria
```
also the packaging change is a 3-line tweak in `tools/package_wheels.sh` to include the new metadata field.

Alex Novak: I can approve the packaging change, but we need sec review if the sdk pulls in native deps or executes post-install scripts. @lily do you want to triage sec?

Lily Gomez: yep, I'll request a quick security review. if it's just metadata and no native deps we can probably fast-track. pls add a brief note in the PR description about runtime/native deps and license.

Ben Hensley: also: because you're editing CODEOWNERS, approvals from current owners of the top-level files are ideal. otherwise platform policy asks for 2 approvers for CODEOWNERS edits.

Maria Chen: ah — didn't realize we needed 2 for CODEOWNERS. ok I'll ping current owners. can we use an approval-exception for speed?

Samir Patel: we can do a temporary approval-exception (label `urgent-approval-exception`) but that needs an eng-platform lead + one other approver to ack in thread. not ideal but allowed for low-risk changes.

deploy-bot: CI check failed — missing license check: `license-check` (details: https://ci.internal/18223)

Maria Chen: fixing license file now, will update. timeline still end of day. tagging reviewers: @Ben Hensley, @Alex Novak, @Lily Gomez — can one of you approve the packaging once CI is green and sec gives the all-clear? :pray:

Ben Hensley: I can take one approval after CI. will wait for sec.

Alex Novak: I'll review packaging and give approval if no native deps.

Lily Gomez: opened a sec quick-check ticket and pinged the security oncall. if they respond OK I'll post here.

Maria Chen: thanks all. will drop a short summary in the PR: what changed, why, and where to look for security/native concerns. also noted that CODEOWNERS change may require a second approver — if we need the exception I'll add label and ask @Samir to co-ack.

Samir Patel: happy to co-ack if you need the exception.

Maria Chen: perfect — will update shortly. :slightly_smiling_face:
